content.text:
The decoder now keeps a nested struct's pre-set defaults when its YAML node is null or holds only comments. With your example, `test.Defaults.Key` stays `"My default Value"`.

The fix is in `createDecodedNewValue` in `decode.go`. When the node is null and the target is a struct whose current value is the same type, it returns that current value instead of a zero value. Other types behave as before.

The decoder now keeps a nested struct's pre-set defaults when its YAML node is null or holds only comments. With your example, `test.Defaults.Key` stays `"My default Value"`.

The fix is in `createDecodedNewValue` in `decode.go`. When the node is null and the target is a struct whose current value is the same type, it returns that current value instead of a zero value. Other types behave as before.
